_meta.doc: doc 43 §0.10 as corrected by doc 49 Part A
_meta.note: Same mechanic as ventures.json (doc 38 §5): a calendar developer project, stakes paid in as a share of the pitched budget, cash calls in thirds, pay/dilute/walk, milestone marks. Every value carries its grade in `provenance`.
_meta.DO_NOT_EXPOSE: demand_trim and the hazard split are rules the engine reads; the player sees only the pitch, the diligence estimate and the news.

pitch.line: A purpose-built AI chip with a third more work per watt than the next mainstream generation, in volume by 2034.

diligence.shows: pitch × the class median (cost ×1.25), P(volume by 2038Q4) ≈ 0.30, the industry's 14% first-silicon success rate

accelerator.slip_note: One draw per game (keyed by type, as M36.10) scales every phase's quarters.

cash_calls.amount: (m − 1) × pitch × stake, in thirds; plus each respin's call

allocation_reservation.deposit_base: reserved MW × GPUs per MW (gpus_v.json) × accel_unit_purchase_usd at signing
allocation_reservation.priority: delivered in the first two quarters after volume, ahead of the foundry-allocation cap

foundry_allocation.note: Reservation holders are served first; the cap falls on everyone else.

after_volume.ebitda: units × unit price × the year's EBITDA share
after_volume.value: stake × max(the mark at volume, quarter EBITDA × 4 × chip_ev_ebitda_mult) for the first 4 quarters; then stake × EBITDA × 4 × chip_ev_ebitda_mult
after_volume.chip_in_market: a GPU class for everyone from max(volume + 1, 2036Q1): gpus_v.json 'bowline'; the market rows before that quarter are masked

marks.slips: each full year past the pitched volume quarter, and each respin

demand_trim.note: On success, ai_demand_index_v × (1 − trim), phased in over 4 quarters from volume (doc 49 Q7).

provenance.budget: [B/C → D] cost to volume $0.5-1.5B (startups raised $0.7-1.75B before material revenue; IBS design cost $449-725M at 5-2 nm [C]); pitch $800M, realised ×1.25 median
provenance.overrun_class: [D] designed: respins (mask sets $20-40M at 3 nm [C]) and burn; Graphcore spent ~$700M without volume [B]
provenance.milestones: [A/B → D] new team design-to-tape-out 18-30 months; tape-out to first silicon ~1 quarter; first silicon to volume 9-18 months for startups (doc 49 Q1)
provenance.slip: [D] fitted: founding to first volume 3.5-5 years for 2016-17 startups [B]; median realised volume 2035Q2
provenance.respin: [A/B → D] 14% of ASIC projects had first-silicon success in 2024 [A/B]; a usable first pass with workarounds ~40-50% [D]; a respin costs 1-2 quarters [C]
provenance.hazards: [C/D] JPR: 146 startups, ~75% expected gone by 2030 [C]; outcome shares from a 27-company sample (doc 49 Q2) [D]
provenance.acquisition: [B → D] gains 10-17x money raised before volume (Nervana, Habana) [B]; losses 0.3-0.9x (Wave, Graphcore) [B]
provenance.reservation: [A/B → D] deposits/loans ~5-10% of contract value (OpenAI-Cerebras $1B against $10-20B) [B]; no published discount; warrants ~10% equity as the equivalent [A/B]
provenance.foundry: [C → D] top four buyers took >90% of CoWoS and HBM in 2025 [C]; startups buy on purchase orders [A]
provenance.after_volume: [A → D] Cerebras gross margin 11.7% → 33.5% → 41.1% (2022-H1 2024) with large losses [A]; EBITDA shares designed
provenance.multiple: [A/C → D] Damodaran semiconductors EV/EBITDA ~35x (Jan 2026, boom) [A/C]; 20x chosen for a single-product newcomer [D]
provenance.demand_trim: [A/C → D] IEA High Efficiency case −15-20% by 2035 for the whole fleet with no rebound [A]; one chip's share ≤ ~2% (doc 49 Q7)
